title: Experts disagree on src/feature-evidence/manifest.ts
context:
Chief architect: The second claim is the test the first must pass, not a rival design. Scoping the requirement to a graduated or full lane on a subagent-capable host is exactly what leaves the fast lane and the non-subagent hosts verifying as they do today.

Target: src/feature-evidence/manifest.ts
- solution-architect: The isolation evidence stream must be required only when isolation was actually expected, which is a graduated or full lane on a host that can dispatch subagents.
- solution-architect: A change on the fast lane, or on a host with no subagent dispatch, must verify exactly as it does today.
